card.name: Digits inside dose strengths
card.fires_on: The final or middle digit of a multi-digit dose number such as 333, 441, 662, 882 or 50 before mg, in dosing lists. It also fires on the word strengths and on /mL after mg.

modes.label: Digits in dose numbers
modes.description: A digit partway or at the end of a tablet or dose strength number, just before mg.
modes.example: No dosage adjustment is necessary in patients taking 44<<1>> mg ARISTADA, if tolerated.

modes.description: The word strengths or the /mL unit after a dose amount.
